title: Full ECU ROM & EEPROM Dumps Over OBD
tagline: Direct memory backup over OBD without desoldering or opening the ECU.
description: Standard diagnostic tools restrict you to basic OBD-II codes. PeeweeSys unlocks full memory-read service 0x23 to stream raw flash and EEPROM data over the standard 16-pin OBD port. Verified on Bosch ME7.2 DME (including complete ST 95040 SPI EEPROM mirror backups) and Siemens / VDO Kombi instrument clusters (2048-byte 93C86 dumps).
highlights: Exact byte-for-byte binary dump of cluster calibration, DME maps, and ST 95040 SPI EEPROM
Safely verified with non-destructive, read-only memory boundary checks over standard K-Line
Instant offline backup before any instrument cluster modification

title: Multi-Module Tamper Detection
description: Unscrupulous sellers can adjust the digits on the instrument cluster, but rarely know how to falsify the independent run-time registers stored in the DME, ABS unit, or Tiptronic transmission. Integrated into our PPI workflow, PeeweeSys pulls all registers simultaneously into one tamper-audit view.
highlights: Simultaneous reading of DME hours, Kombi odometer, and transmission operating time
Highlights statistical discrepancies (e.g. suspiciously low average speed under 20 km/h)
Zero subscription lock-in — scan any car before you buy

title: 17,000+ Enriched Fault Code Library
tagline: Decoded Porsche-specific dealer DTC definitions in plain English & German.
description: Generic scanners display vague 'Unknown Fault PXXXX' messages for proprietary Porsche body, alarm, climate, and chassis codes. PeeweeSys features a comprehensive library of over 17,400 factory fault definitions with official freeze frame descriptors and diagnostic context.
highlights: 17,437 decoded Porsche trouble codes across DME, ABS/PSM, Alarm, Airbag, Climate, and Kombi
Full dual-language support: official factory English and authentic German engineering terminology
Decodes complex freeze frames and environmental conditions for intermittent glitches

title: Pre-Clear Snapshot Reports
tagline: Never lose critical diagnostic freeze frame data again.
description: Generic scan tools erase fault codes blindly with a single press, destroying freeze frame conditions (engine RPM, engine temp, load) needed to pinpoint intermittent misfires. PeeweeSys enforces a non-destructive snapshot workflow with structured export before clearing. Verified across 5 modules simultaneously.
highlights: Captures all DTCs, freeze frames, and module versions into a permanent HTML/PDF dossier
Strict car-tested whitelist prevents sending unverified clear commands to sensitive ECUs
Automatic post-clear re-scan confirms whether faults are static or transient

title: Speedometer Recalibration
tagline: Fix 4–7% factory over-read and compensate for aftermarket wheels.
description: Nearly all modern classic Porsche instrument clusters intentionally over-read speed by 4 to 8 km/h at highway speeds. True enthusiasts want GPS-calibrated precision. Backend surgical write and K-Zahl impulse calibration verified on car (uk_1to1 on K24 cluster). Dedicated user-friendly UI/UX and digital dash RAM speed readout verification currently in beta development before General Availability.
highlights: Surgically verified on live vehicle K24 cluster (uk_1to1 calibration curve) with clean DTC log
Compensates for aftermarket wheel diameters and tire aspect ratios
Digital display RAM speed readout verification currently in beta lane

title: Used Donor Cluster Migration Wizard
tagline: Pair replacement clusters with authentic VIN & true mileage without $2,500 dealer virgin parts.
description: Faded LCD pixels or failing stepper motors are common on 986 and 996 dashboards. Dealership PIWIS tools enforce an artificial software lock that permanently rejects used replacement clusters with over 100 km, forcing owners to purchase $2,500 virgin units. PeeweeSys donor migration wizard is in beta: cryptographically backup your original cluster, transfer tank/oil calibration curves and equipment coding, and safely pair the replacement cluster to your car's genuine VIN and verified DME mileage.
highlights: Bypasses official dealer software block on used donor instrument clusters (>100 km)
Transfers tank sensor curves, oil level calibration, and regional country equipment coding
Pairs the donor cluster to your authentic VIN and verified DME odometer record

title: Coolant Gauge Linearization
tagline: Researching cluster curve to eliminate factory 80°C–105°C dummy buffer.
description: From the factory, Porsche programmed the 986 and 996 coolant gauge needle to stay dead-center at 80°C (180°F) whether your actual engine coolant is 80°C, 95°C, or 105°C to avoid customer service inquiries. This feature is currently in active development: mapping the needle plateau interpolation curve in cluster memory so we can safely linearize it without unintended side effects.
highlights: Active research phase to identify exact needle plateau curve in cluster memory
Non-destructive memory mapping to verify sensor response before writing
Goal: remove artificial dampening so your needle reflects true coolant temp

title: Guided Pre-Purchase Inspection (PPI)
tagline: Step-by-step diagnostic test plans and live health logging.
description: Standard scanners passively read fault codes. In development: PeeweeSys guided interactive inspection plans checking module states, cold/hot startup routines, live sensor telemetry, and compiling an authoritative PDF health dossier for prospective buyers and owners.
highlights: Guided interactive workflows: ignition on, engine crank, warm-up logging, actuator testing
Automatic multi-module consistency check (DME hours, Kombi mileage, transmission run-time)
Generates an immutable inspection dossier with freeze frames and live sensor graphs

title: Digital Dash & Live Telemetry
tagline: Live cluster internals: true unbuffered coolant, battery voltage, and raw sensors.
description: In development: stream raw instrument cluster memory directly in your browser. Surfaces real-time unbuffered coolant temperature in exact °C (free from factory gauge damping), battery charging voltage at 0.05V resolution, fuel tank sender resistance in ohms, and internal decoded digital speed.
highlights: Direct memory-mapped telemetry stream from cluster MCU
Reveals true engine temperature and charging system health before dash warning lamps illuminate
Live logging and export for diagnosing intermittent electrical or cooling faults
